label: theTargetIsTheSelectedLayerOnTheCanvas: the target is read from the composite, so a fill or heal bakes the other layers into the selected one
selectionCoverageOnly: no selection reads as the whole canvas, so Remove fills the whole image when nothing is painted or selected
find: guard let canvas, let selection else { return nil }
replace:
guard let canvas else { return nil }
        let selection = selection ?? canvas.rect

label: editsSelectedLayer: Heal's release keeps the clone preview under the heal, so undo leaves the preview behind
editsSelectedLayer: Heal's release runs another command than retouch.heal, so the stroke heals nothing and records no step
